bias.zh: 反弹 · 自 $240.7 回落，低于 10 日均线

read.en: Coherent rose 1.0% on Nov 19 to $214.94, but opened at $230.50 and faded from a $240.66 high to a $211.20 low. It is above the 5-day ($212.0, falling) and just under the 10-day ($216.0, rising), and below the 30-day ($227.7), 100-day ($280.1) and 200-day ($296.7), all falling. MACD has been above its signal since Nov 10, below zero, histogram widening slightly; Parabolic SAR has been bullish since Nov 9 ($180.95), and RSI is 45.8.
read.zh: Coherent 11月19日上涨 1.0%，收于 $214.94，但开盘 $230.50 后自 $240.66 高点回落至 $211.20 低点。股价位于 5 日均线（$212.0，下行）上方，略低于 10 日均线（$216.0，上行），并位于 30 日（$227.7）、100 日（$280.1）和 200 日均线（$296.7）下方，三者均在下行。MACD 自 11月10日起位于信号线上方，在零轴下方，柱状图略有放大；抛物线 SAR 自 11月9日起看多（$180.95），RSI 为 45.8。

read.en: No level changed on the close: the $240.66 high cleared every resistance up to the Nov 11 and 12 closes intraday, but the close fell back under the 10-day. Resistance is $216–219.2 (10-day, Nov 13 close, Nov 18 high), then $225.2–227.7 (Nov 9 close, 30-day) and $232.1–240.7. Support is $210.9–212 (5-day, Nov 17 close, Nov 19 low), then $203.4–204.8 and $196. A close above $219.2 would target $225–228; below $210.9, $204.

r.en: Nov 12 close $232.08; Nov 11 close $234.51; Nov 19 high $240.66
